status.degradedTag: does not match the selected mode "{{mode}}"

modeInfo.self_signed: The panel issues and renews the certificate itself. Works immediately, with no external dependencies — the browser will show "not secure", which is expected. Always available as a fallback, even if another mode is selected.
modeInfo.acme: Automatic issuance via the ACME protocol — Let's Encrypt or any compatible server (e.g. a private step-ca). Requires a real domain pointing at this server.
modeInfo.manual: Paste a certificate and key obtained by any other means (manual certbot, corporate CA, etc.) — if automatic issuance is unavailable from this network.
modeInfo.proxy: TLS is terminated by an external reverse proxy (Traefik, etc.), and the panel responds over plain HTTP only to the proxy itself. Requires TRUST_PROXY enabled on the server. Switching to this mode and back only takes effect after the panel container is restarted (the HTTPS listener itself is only recreated at process start).

keyAlgo.label: Key algorithm
keyAlgo.tip: From the most compatible/fastest (RSA-2048) to the strictest (ECDSA P-384). ECDSA P-256 is a sensible default.

renewBefore.label: Reissue ahead of time (days before expiry)
renewBefore.tip: How many days before expiry the panel will automatically reissue the certificate. You can set a fixed number of days or a fraction of the validity period — if the validity period is short, use a smaller value.

sans.label: Certificate domains/IPs (comma-separated)
sans.tip: How you actually access the panel — a domain and/or an IP. Empty = localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 (only suitable for testing on this same machine).

presets.letsEncryptStaging: Let's Encrypt (staging — for testing, no limits on real certificates)

directoryUrl.label: Directory URL
directoryUrl.tip: The ACME server address. For a private server (e.g. step-ca), specify its directory endpoint explicitly.

acme.email: Email (for expiry notifications from the CA)

challenge.label: Domain verification method
challenge.tip: TLS-ALPN-01 — doesn't require an open port 80, works right through the same port as the panel. HTTP-01 — the classic method, but requires an externally reachable port 80.

trustRoot.label: Trusted root certificate (optional)
trustRoot.tip: Only needed for a private ACME server with its own root that isn't part of the system's trusted CAs (typical for step-ca).

keyPem.label: Private key (PEM)
keyPem.tip: Leave empty to keep the already uploaded key and replace only the certificate — otherwise you must provide the full pair (the key is not shown again after saving).
